mapper.select: SELECT no, category, title, writer, content, created_at, updated_at, view_count FROM board ORDER BY no DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board ( category, title, writer, content, created_at, updated_at, view_count ) VALUES ( #{category}, #{title}, #{writer}, #{content}, NOW(), NOW(), 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE board SET category = #{category}, title = #{title}, writer = #{writer}, content = #{content}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE no = #{no}
